name: Jaime Valencia
office: City of Commerce, Member of the City Council

items.text: Jaime Valencia works as an advanced-certified automotive technician and previously spent 30 years as an accountant. He previously served as a Planning Commissioner and Education Commissioner for the city.

sentences.text: Jaime Valencia works as an advanced-certified automotive technician and previously spent 30 years as an accountant.
He previously served as a Planning Commissioner and Education Commissioner for the city.

items.text: His campaign priorities include addressing vehicle theft and illegal fireworks, improving programs for families and seniors, promoting responsible development, and ensuring transparency in public spending. He also supports moving forward with the redevelopment of Veterans Park.
